primary_task: Create, edit, deploy and localize a declarative agent for M365 Copilot using the ATK CLI, deploying after every edit and returning the M365 test link.

requirements.name: atk (@microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli)
requirements.evidence: Run `npx -y --package @microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli atk --version` to confirm ATK CLI is installed
requirements.observed: 1.1.17 (not run via npx to avoid installing)

requirements.name: Microsoft 365 tenant account (signed into ATK)
requirements.evidence: Deploy After EVERY Edit ... atk provision --env local ... read M365_TITLE_ID
requirements.observed: no M365 credential variables, no ~/.fx ATK login state

notes: Doc says if ATK not found, stop and do not install; ATK is fetched by npx on demand which is installable. Pure manifest editing is possible, but the doc mandates deploy after every edit.
